conditional_herbs_note: Accepted 2026-11-15. A ninth jar that is on the shelf only while flags.json gutter_sand is above 0: sweeping the hub fills it, one spoon a sweep, two at most. It is kept out of 'herbs' because no scene finds it and no brew's jar list can count on it.

The thin, pencil phase (tea_hold 1 to 29) keeps its full line and colour.
Heat builds at half the rate; the written line pulls 20% harder.

parting_cup.ledger_line: For leaving a book that is still going: sprig, and what the book gives back
parting_cup.note: Accepted 2026-11-15. No cup made from the eight jars reaches depth 7 at binding -4. With the sprig the ledger names, only sprig and two spoons of gutter sand do (mark 3, or mark 4 at depth 8 and binding -4). Phase 1 builds the recipe and the cup. What the cup lets Elaris do (close a book without stopping it) is phase 3.

brews.note: Tutorial; any sprig works at mark 3.
Most solutions bind 4; the clever one binds 2.
Three constraints; lamp-ash is not yet found.
The last pot: the player's choice. Its binding is the last push on steep.
